lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A prominent horizontal arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters is visible posterior to the gill region. There are roughly three parallel horizontal rows of spots, with the largest and most intense blobs occupying the median row along the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal spot rows, creating a subtle grid-like pattern where the blobs act as nodal points, most clearly visible in the anterior half of the exposed flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two distinct horizontal ridges (carinae) are visible running along the upper third of the flank. Each ridge is defined by a sharp vertical pixel intensity gradient, with high-luminance values along the top edge transitioning into a distinct shadow-filled trough immediately below.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple small, slender, high-luminance organisms (likely remoras) are attached to and trailing from the posterior edge of the left pectoral fin. The trailing edge of this pectoral fin also exhibits irregular margins and minor fraying.
